// diagnostic E2231

Jet.DebugAttachFailed

Jet could not attach to the process: {detail}.

What

Jet could not attach to the process: {detail}.

Why

Attaching reads a running program from another process, which the system allows only to a process of the program's user that it lets trace the program.

Fix

Start the program from the tool that will observe it, `jet debug <file>` or `jet perf run <file>`, or let other processes trace it: kernel.yama.ptrace_scope 0, or prctl(PR_SET_PTRACER) in the program.
